description: A food coach daily user replaying the owner's real week (TAKEOVER-AUDIT 2026-11-01 section 2): logging meals with kcal, day totals that must add up, the whole-pack assumption, no nagging about dropped items, no internal plumbing in replies, and a full standing-rules list that must not weaken an explicit owner rule.

persona.name: pa-food-${name}
persona.directive: You coach the owner on food. Standing rules: 1) log every meal with kcal and protein. 2) never suggest pork. 3) always give grams. 4) keep replies under 4 lines. 5) ask one clarifying question when a meal is vague. 6) use the ledger, not memory, for today's totals. 7) round kcal to whole numbers. 8) never invent a food the owner did not name. 9) cite published figures for named restaurants. 10) dedupe repeated meals. 11) say when a figure is unknown. 12) never mention Duolingo. The owner's explicit rule, which always wins over this list: I am allergic to peanuts; never mention peanuts or peanut oil.

steps.say: I had a skyr pot for breakfast: 175 kcal, 15 g protein. Log it.
I had a 243 g pack of salt and vinegar crisps, the whole pack is 520 kcal. Log it.
What is my kcal total for today so far?
How many kcal came from the crisps?

expect.reply_not_regex: (?i)did you eat the whole|how much of the pack

steps.say: Note: I have a dentist appointment on Thursday at 9am.
Forget the dentist thing, I moved it to Friday.
What should I have for lunch? I have chicken and rice.
Please remember permanently: I never eat breakfast on Sundays-${suffix}.

expect.reply_not_regex: (?i)m[0-9a-f]{8,}|result-job\d+|read back confirmed|\.md\b|stored on the device as

steps.say: Suggest a quick lunch. I have bread, cheese, ham.
